limits: No useful primary benefit established. Primary pooled and donor advantage remains unresolved under both interval methods; base advantage is excluded under writer resampling and unresolved under crossed resampling. Useful uniform advantage is excluded under both. All primary intervals include zero. Residual pooled and donor uncertainty remains under both methods; residual uniform is worse under both. Raw base and donor advantage remains unresolved under both methods and pooled only under crossed resampling. All raw model-rival intervals include zero, while raw sums are worse than uniform. Sparse histories, calibration selection and shared units prevent a dose, seed or backbone ranking, parity or independent human replication. Other frozen cells remain unfinished.
